MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The ten-foot HDMI cable feels useful because it offers extra reach beyond the six-foot cable I previously chose, helping connect my existing equipment.",
    "The microSD card feels like a practical spare for my Raspberry Pi projects, connecting my Pi kit purchase with my earlier memory-card purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming sticks, tablets and Alexa devices introduce activities I have not shown a current need for; my recent choices concern connecting, organizing and maintaining computer equipment.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender relates to networking, but my Ethernet adapter and cables suggest a wired setup, not a wireless coverage problem.",
    "Having chosen a Kindle does not mean I need a Fire tablet; reading and wanting another general-purpose screen are different needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any connected household device.",
    "My Amazon-branded purchases seem to have been taken as interest in Alexa and Fire products, even though those purchases served specific practical purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases bring together wired networking, headphone storage and computer cleaning, suggesting that improving my existing setup matters right now.",
    "Accessories appeal when they solve a particular problem or support equipment I already use; another cable needs useful extra reach, and another memory card needs a plausible project use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The cable and memory card fit practical uses in my existing setup, but most suggestions mistake my interest in computer accessories for a desire to add entertainment and smart-home devices."
}
